articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5 in early July 2026, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show substantial gains in mathematical proof verification, complex code generation, and long-document analysis, narrowing the gap with specialized domain models.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Research Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2 with breakthrough performance on FrontierMath and GPQA-Diamond benchmarks, solving previously unsolved graduate-level problems in physics and mathematics. The model integrates a novel mixture-of-experts architecture with tool-use capabilities that allow it to autonomously invoke symbolic math engines and simulation environments.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment to Three Additional Manufacturing Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the expansion of its Figure 02 humanoid robot deployment across three new BMW manufacturing facilities in Europe, scaling from a pilot of 50 units to over 400 robots performing assembly, logistics, and quality inspection tasks. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation without explicit reprogramming.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Multi-Step Repair Tasks in Industrial Settings
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas robot autonomously diagnosing and executing multi-step mechanical repair procedures in a Hyundai engine plant, including tool selection, fastener manipulation, and torque verification. The system uses a combination of reinforcement learning and foundation model-based planning that generalizes across previously unseen repair scenarios.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Real-Time Computer Use Agent for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic released a production-grade computer-use agent built on Claude that can navigate enterprise software, execute multi-application workflows, and handle exception cases with human-in-the-loop escalation. Early enterprise adopters report 40-60% reduction in time spent on routine back-office processes involving ERP, CRM, and ticketing systems.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that risk production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node has commenced at its Fab 20 facility in Hsinchu, approximately one quarter ahead of the original roadmap. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery, projecting an 18% speed improvement and 25% power reduction over N2.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Behemoth with 2 Trillion Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta publicly released the full Llama 4 Behemoth model weights, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that rivals proprietary frontier models on reasoning and coding tasks. The release includes optimized inference kernels for multi-node deployment and a distillation toolkit, accelerating the open-source ecosystem's access to frontier-class capabilities.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 500 Wh/kg in Production-Intent Cells
articles.summary: QuantumScape announced that its latest generation solid-state lithium-metal cells have achieved 500 Wh/kg energy density at the cell level in production-intent form factors, with over 1,000 fast-charge cycles to 80% capacity retention. The milestone could enable EVs with 600+ mile range and has drawn new investment commitments from multiple automakers for 2028 vehicle integration.
